0.2.2.en: Don't disable devices, but use dim to turn them on/off

0.3.0.en: Added state-change handling and implemented dim capability

0.4.0.en: reuse connection and sockets, implemented reconnect functionality

0.5.0.en: Fix silent control failures: send control only after the websocket wire is opened (queue otherwise), log all server wireStatus responses, use dedicated OnOff control, add colour/temperature support, debounce reconnects to avoid API-key throttling.

0.6.0.en: Fix app crash on startup with newer Homey CLI (guard inspector.open), and recognise Casambi's updated wire-open acknowledgement ("openWireSucceed") so control commands are sent again.

0.6.1.en: Show lights as unavailable when the Casambi gateway is offline, so Homey no longer looks connected while commands cannot reach the luminaires. Share one session when the same account is saved with different email casing.

0.6.2.en: Clarify the offline message: Homey needs the Casambi app's Gateway mode connected to the cloud.

0.6.3.en: Turn lights back on by restoring the dimmer level. Dimmer-only Casambi fixtures ignore an OnOff-only command, so they stayed off.

0.6.4.en: Recover automatically after Casambi firmware, gateway and session drops: ignore stale websocket reconnects, refresh expired sessions, re-open the wire on networkUpdated, poll REST state, and accept renamed server acknowledgements so on/off/dim and status keep working.

0.6.5.en: Detect lights that look connected but no longer respond: every command is now confirmed against the light's reported state, and if it is not confirmed within 10 seconds the app reconnects and resends it once. Also reconnects when the cloud stops answering keep-alives, the wire open is never acknowledged, or the server closes the wire. Adds a health endpoint for monitoring.
